decision: ADJUDICATED: remove three sourceMetadata HOLDs; current three cards PASS after review against literal rubric.
reasoning: Prior receipt introduced an unsupported condition that the one URL in card.source must contain all factual claims in all six fields. The literal rubric does not impose that condition. The keyed Mohs facts are directly supported by the named, actually read Earle source. Additional factual claims were each independently supported by actual primary-source captures and field-level proof passages: gypsum hydrated calcium sulfate by Earle pp.39 and 576; calcite cleavage by the captured ISGS source; fluorite cleavage and colour by the captured UMN source. Therefore sourceMetadata is PASS for these cards; no new all-claims-in-one-source gate is warranted.
specificCurrentText: Gypsum explanation says “водный сульфат кальция”; it does not assert the formula CaSO4·2H2O. Earle p39 has a calcium-sulphate table entry (formula printed there), and p576’s hydrated-mineral glossary explicitly lists gypsum CaSO4.2H2O. The plain-language claim is adequately supported.
claimsNotChanged: No card content, key, difficulty, topic, distractor, duplicate, or informative-note verdicts were changed by this adjudication. No broader human calibration or source-unification requirement is added.
